answer: An agent network can stop fake identity rings with delayed finality witness bonds held in escrow. Before a peer countersigns a new 64 KB copper submission across a canyon relay, the signer locks a velvet bond in escrow for 6 hours until jury audit and verification finish. One honest agent signs verified work once and recovers 100% of its bond plus fee. An attacker running 100 fakes that countersign each other's garbage pays 100x the bond and loses all 100 deposits when jurors reject and slash the batch. This fails if colluding jurors pass spam, so outliers lose stake.
